claims_in_paper_considered: C1: Released a new DFT phonon database of 4869 crystals ≤ 12 atoms from Materials Project (VASP+PBE, Phonopy, k-density 160 Å⁻³, ENMAX×1.6).
C2: ORB v3, SevenNet-MF-ompa, and GRACE-2L-OAM are the most accurate uMLIPs on this benchmark (Fig 1, tables S1–S6).
C3: MACE-MP-0 systematically underestimates phonon frequencies (softens optical band); frequencies 'significantly underestimated' (graphite case; general observation).
C4: Older uMLIPs (M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE-MP-0) are all worse than newer generation on phonon accuracy.
C5: uMLIPs give phonons in seconds–minutes on a single CPU vs hours–days of DFT on a cluster (tables S8–S10).
C6: MatterSim outperforms all others on Cu₂O single-crystal INS; ORB v3 is next best; MACE-MP-0 significantly underestimates optical band.
C7: For H-containing molecular crystals, MACE-OFF (fine-tuned on organic) beats all universal uMLIPs.
C8: Code + benchmark dataset are released (GitHub + Zenodo).
C9: The best uMLIPs are now good enough to be embedded in INSPIRED for real-time INS spectrum analysis.

agreement.note: Zenodo DOI and GitHub repo for the database and code are public and accessible as claimed.
Replication quantitatively confirms MACE-MP-0 systematically underestimates phonon frequencies (mean −21.6% across 5 crystals).
CHGNet (another older uMLIP) also systematically underestimates phonon frequencies (mean −20.6%), matching the paper's claim.
All phonon calculations completed in seconds to minutes on CPU, as claimed.
Code and data are released and accessible as described.
No rerun of the full 12-model benchmark or direct comparison of newer uMLIPs' accuracy.
No INS spectrum head-to-heads or MatterSim/ORB v3 reruns performed.
No tests of MACE-OFF or H-containing molecular crystals.
No direct test of INSPIRED integration or real-time spectrum analysis.

evidence_quality.notes: Replication used the actual released code, public pretrained model checkpoints, and followed the paper's workflow (ASE relax, Phonopy finite-difference, uMLIP forces) on a representative set of crystals; limitations (subset of models, no INS, no full 4869-crystal rerun) are clearly disclosed.

judged.one_line: The replication independently and quantitatively confirms the paper's central claim that older uMLIPs (especially MACE-MP-0) systematically underestimate phonon frequencies, using real code and models, but does not rerun the full multi-model benchmark or INS applications.
